title: Skills persist evidence on every non-skipped run
statement: Every devai agent skill run X invocation whose result has status in {pass, fail, review} MUST persist an evidence record at .devai/state/skills/<X>/<ISO-timestamp>.json containing at minimum the skill_id, status, and the result.evidence payload. status=skipped runs are exempt. The persisted file MUST be what the CLI reports as evidence_path.
rationale: Article 33 makes the auditor the state estimator of the loop, and Article 35 makes the backlog the only work queue: both depend on every skill outcome being a recoverable artifact. A skill that runs without leaving a trace is invisible to the auditor and to every downstream tool. The persistence is best-effort: persistence failure must surface in the result but never block emit; the skill's `evidence_path` field is the link the rest of the framework follows.

strategy.rationale: The registered test corpus provides deterministic regression evidence for this invariant.
